result.summary: The page layout is largely coherent, but several rendering and consistency defects stand out: clipped text in the horizontal restaurant carousel, an implausible "-100%" discount badge, inconsistent favorite-button styling, and a bottom card cropped by the tab bar. Contrast on the promo banner code text and the truncated category chip are lesser concerns.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card ('Trattoria Piccol…' / '€1.90 delivery') is hard-clipped at the screen edge with no ellipsis or fade, so the title and price appear cut mid-word rather than intentionally peeking.
issues.suggestion: Constrain card text width and apply text-overflow: ellipsis, and add a consistent peek/fade gutter so partially visible cards look intentional.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card shows a '-100%' discount badge, which implies the item is free and is almost certainly a data or formatting error (likely a mis-mapped discount value).
issues.suggestion: Validate discount values and cap/format them correctly (e.g. '-50%' or 'Free item'); guard against 0/100 edge values from the API.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the first card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart, the second uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Use one shared favorite-button component with a fixed background treatment (e.g. semi-transparent scrim) so it reads consistently over any image.

issues.description: The second popular restaurant card is cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible name, rating, or delivery info, and there appears to be no bottom padding accounting for the tab bar/home indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar + safe-area height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut at the right edge showing only a sliver of the next chip, with no scroll affordance indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/peek or a fade gradient so the chip row clearly signals it is scrollable.

issues.description: The first carousel card ('Green Bowl Poké') has a light grey image background while the other cards use dark imagery, making the row look visually unbalanced.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image treatment (consistent aspect ratio and background/overlay) across carousel thumbnails.

issues.description: Secondary text on the green promo banner ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') and the grey search placeholder are low-contrast against their backgrounds.
issues.suggestion: Increase text opacity/weight to meet at least 4.5:1 contrast for body text.
